output.summary: A low shrub or small tree native to the Canary Islands, western Morocco and Western Sahara. Its spineless, partly succulent stems carry leaves clustered at their tips. In the Canary Islands, the leaves were gathered and cooked as greens, while its milky latex is poisonous.
output.edibilityNote: In the Canary Islands, leaves were historically gathered and cooked as a green vegetable; the milky latex is poisonous.
